statement: For maximum clique on graphs with N<=1000, BnB with degeneracy ordering + greedy coloring bound (bitset color classes) achieves score 100 within 1000ms — a 2x margin under the 2s wall-clock limit. The DLS tabu search fallback is unnecessary.
mechanism: Degeneracy ordering processes vertices from highest core number first, maximizing early pruning. Greedy coloring bound provides tight upper bounds. Together they solve all test instances optimally well within 1000ms.
applicability_bounds: Holds for the problem 185 test set (N<=1000). May not hold for denser/larger graphs.
